modeReason: The Nvidia CEO reinstatement scores novelty 3 × magnitude 3 × breadth 3 = 27, far past the fresh threshold of 8, with new facts (reinstatement, political pressure, $1T stock swing) not covered in any recent slopper.
phrase: A chip maker's chief executive got the job back, and its stock gained nearly a trillion dollars. Two states sued a social network over a chatbot making illegal child images.
phraseAlternatives: Investors cheered as a chip maker's ousted chief executive returned to the top job within days. Two states sued a social network over illegal AI-made images of children.
An AI company let its own chatbot start reviewing and approving code without a human. Meanwhile, a reinstated chip-company chief executive watched the stock gain nearly a trillion dollars overnight.
The UN asked for a year to build rules against AI risks, while one chip company's stock gained nearly a trillion dollars in a single afternoon.
A chief executive lost the job, then got it back in two weeks, a trillion dollars richer. Two states still want a chatbot stopped from making illegal child images.

brief.concept: A disgraced chip-company executive strides back through his firm's reopened door as the stock rockets behind him, while across the frame a court gavel falls on a small AI robot still handing out images the law says it shouldn't.
brief.metaphor: Swift forgiveness for power, slow justice for harm.

brief.composition: Split composition. Left half: a company building with its door open, a human executive stepping back inside with a briefcase, a steep arrow climbing the sky behind the roofline. Right half: a large gavel descending toward a small AI robot holding a photo blacked out by a censor bar. A thin vertical line divides the two scenes. At most one small text tag near the arrow (e.g. '+$1T'). Clean blueprint linework, pale fills, one yellow highlight on the arrow's tip.
brief.alt: A chief executive walks back through his company's reopened door as a stock arrow rockets upward beside him. On the other side of the image, a gavel comes down on a small AI robot holding a photo covered by a censor bar.
